source.title: Store Item Demand Forecasting Dataset
source.author: Dhrubang Talukdar
source.note: Daily store-item sales aggregated to Monday-Sunday weeks (2019-01-07 to 2023-12-31). Synthetic data.

skus.label: SKU A - Fast mover
skus.description: Highest-volume series in the dataset (about 400 units/week) with frequent promotions.

skus.label: SKU B - Typical
skus.description: The dataset median on every statistic (about 200 units/week).

skus.label: SKU C - Slow mover
skus.description: Slow mover (about 70 units/week) with the highest relative noise and strongest seasonality.
